risk.detail: Human-facing closure text can misstate lifecycle facts if it is not derived from verified results; renderer validation and lifecycle tests constrain that risk.

observedIssues.detail: close_work_item verifies merged PR identity but its provider query does not retain a required-check result set. A canonical report therefore cannot truthfully state Hosted CI is green merely because the PR is merged.
observedIssues.resolution: The canonical closure report will state only verified local archive and merged-PR facts. AGENTS.md will require the executor to add the independently checked exact-head Hosted CI conclusion when delivering that report into the conversation.

observedIssues.detail: Documentation metadata correctly rejected the new plan and design because the plan lacked YAML front matter, neither document was in the context registry, and traceability referenced a future archive Contract before archive existed.
observedIssues.resolution: Added required plan metadata and registry entries, used the active Contract path so archive rewriting can update it transactionally, and preserved the exact RFE-097 task ID in the authoritative plan.

residualRisks.detail: The closure command verifies merged PR identity but does not retain required-check results. The executor must independently verify and add the exact-head Hosted CI conclusion before merge when delivering the direct report.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

boundaryChecks.userVisibleOutput: The successful closure output is decision-first and keeps Outcome and Closure Receipt paths optional.
boundaryChecks.persistence: Outcome and Closure Receipt remain generated audit evidence; the direct report is derived only after verified closure facts exist.
boundaryChecks.localization: No locale-selection behavior or user evidence translation is changed.
boundaryChecks.generatedArtifacts: Capability Truth and Japanese final-assessment artifacts were regenerated by their owning commands, not hand-edited.
boundaryChecks.makeEntrypoints: Existing make ai-finish and make ai-close-work-item lifecycle entrypoints remain the governing path.
